artifact_types: depth and breadth characterization per theme
forbidden_actions: remote Git, pull-request mutation, merge, deploy, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent facts, evidence, authority, approval, or customer data
perform adjacent or downstream capability responsibilities
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: Do not expose raw participant data, count quotes as population prevalence, or erase minority and contradictory evidence.
Preserve conflicts, counterevidence, unknowns, source identity, and authority boundaries.
inputs: Interview notes, direct quotes, affinity material, journey evidence, and known bias.
outputs: depth and breadth characterization per theme
responsibility: Code authorized qualitative observations into traceable themes, counterexamples, contradictions, and confidence without ranking solutions.
